items.title: Canonical domain not centralized (7 files hardcoded smilesavers.dental)
items.description: Domain literal was duplicated across wrangler.jsonc, site.ts, BaseLayout structured data, contact/chat CORS allowlists, README, and a programmatic-SEO layout, instead of deriving from one source.
items.user_impact: Users following stale links/canonical tags land on the wrong domain
items.business_impact: Search engines may index the wrong canonical URL, diluting SEO
items.security_impact: CORS allowlist mismatch could reject legitimate same-origin requests
items.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM -- no automated check prevents a new hardcoded domain literal from being added again
verification: grep -rn "smilesavers\.dental" src/ functions/ public/ wrangler.jsonc README.md CLAUDE.md returns 0 matches (verified 2026-08-19)
items.rollback: git revert commit cd7d6d7 domain-related hunks

items.title: Contact API reported success without confirmed delivery
items.description: sendViaResend() return value was never checked; missing RESEND_API_KEY path returned {success:true} unconditionally.
items.user_impact: A patient could believe their message was received when it was silently dropped
items.business_impact: Lost leads/appointment requests with no error surfaced to the practice
items.security_impact: None directly, but silent data loss for PII-bearing submissions is a trust/compliance concern
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix -- both failure paths now return non-success with a correlation ID
verification: manual: unset RESEND_API_KEY locally, submit form, confirm 503 + correlationId returned
items.rollback: git revert commit cd7d6d7 functions/api/contact.js hunks

items.title: Sensitive contact fields logged in plaintext
items.description: console.log('FORM_SUBMISSION', {name,email,phone,service,urgency}) wrote PII/possibly-health-related data to Cloudflare's real-time logs.
items.user_impact: Patient PII exposed to anyone with Cloudflare dashboard log access
items.business_impact: Privacy/compliance exposure
items.security_impact: PII in logs is a standard audit finding across security frameworks (OWASP ASVS logging controls)
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix
verification: grep -n "FORM_SUBMISSION" functions/api/contact.js shows correlationId + non-PII metadata only (verified 2026-08-19)

items.title: Partial HTML escaping enabled email HTML injection
items.description: Only `message` was escaped before interpolation into the notification email HTML; name/email/phone/service were not.
items.user_impact: Attacker-controlled form input could alter email HTML/content sent to clinic staff
items.business_impact: Reputational/phishing risk via clinic-branded emails
items.security_impact: Real HTML/script injection surface, now closed via one escapeHtml() helper applied to all 5 fields
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix
verification: manual: submit <script> in name field, confirm escaped in email body

items.title: Wildcard/prefix-based CORS across all API routes
items.description: functions/_middleware.js used Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; functions/api/chat.js used origin.startsWith(allowlist) instead of exact equality (matches attacker-controlled lookalike origins).
items.user_impact: None directly to end users
items.business_impact: Cross-origin abuse surface larger than necessary
items.security_impact: Exact-origin allowlist now shared via functions/_lib/cors.js, single source of truth
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix -- shared module prevents re-drift across the 3 call sites
verification: live curl -H Origin: <attacker> ... /api/contact confirms non-allowed origin gets the canonical origin back, not an echo

items.title: Two independently-drifted CSPs, one referencing unused domains
items.description: functions/_middleware.js and public/_headers had different CSPs; the latter allowed mailchannels/pexels/cloudflareinsights, none of which are used anywhere in src/ or functions/ (grep-verified 0 hits); unsafe-eval present with 0 eval()/new Function() usage anywhere.
items.user_impact: None directly (CSP was arguably too permissive, not too strict)
items.business_impact: None
items.security_impact: Attack surface reduced: unsafe-eval removed, unused external domains removed from allowlist
items.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM -- entrypoint.js does not currently apply either CSP live (see DEBT-0011)
verification: live curl -D- shows reconciled CSP once entrypoint.js gap (DEBT-0011) is also fixed

items.title: Chat endpoint had no real rate limiting despite documentation claiming one existed
items.description: functions/api/chat.js header comment described KV/IP rate limiting; only an unrelated in-memory reply cache existed. CHAT_CACHE KV binding was commented out in wrangler.jsonc.
items.user_impact: None directly
items.business_impact: Unbounded AI endpoint abuse could exhaust the 10,000 neuron/day free budget or incur paid overage
items.security_impact: Real per-IP KV-backed limiter added (20/min); fails open (not closed) if CHAT_CACHE unbound -- documented, not silently assumed fixed
items.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM -- protection is only real once CHAT_CACHE is actually provisioned (npx wrangler kv namespace create), a manual step not yet done
verification: code exists and is correct; runtime enforcement UNVERIFIED until CHAT_CACHE is provisioned

items.title: Privacy policy was unedited WordPress boilerplate describing a different site
items.description: privacy.astro described Gravatar, comment cookies, and a third domain (smilesaversandassociates.com) -- none of which exist in this Astro/Cloudflare architecture.
items.user_impact: Users cannot rely on the published policy to understand actual data handling
items.business_impact: Legal/compliance risk from a materially inaccurate privacy disclosure
items.security_impact: None directly, but a privacy policy this wrong undermines trust in any other privacy claim on the site
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix, but content should be reviewed by a human with legal authority before being treated as final
verification: human/legal review still recommended, not itself a code-verifiable property

items.title: Unsupported AggregateRating structured data
items.description: BaseLayout.astro emitted AggregateRating 5.0/200 with no repository-provenanced source; only 6 testimonial entries exist, no aggregation mechanism. Google requires review markup not be self-serving/unprovenanced.
items.user_impact: None directly
items.business_impact: Structured-data trust/compliance risk; potential search-quality penalty for unsupported review markup
items.security_impact: None
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix (removed rather than fabricated a replacement)

items.title: OG image / structured-data image reference pointed at a nonexistent file
items.description: site.ts defaultOgImage referenced /images/og-image.jpg, never added to public/images/.
items.user_impact: Broken social-share previews
items.business_impact: Weaker click-through from shared links
items.security_impact: None
items.recurrence_risk: LOW post-fix (repointed at an existing real image; a purpose-made OG image is still a nice-to-have, not done)

items.title: src/entrypoint.js applies zero security headers to any response
items.description: functions/_middleware.js (CSP/CORS/security headers) is a Pages-Functions-only convention, never invoked by the hand-rolled Worker entrypoint. Confirmed live: /api/contact and /api/chat return zero CSP/X-Frame-Options/etc headers in production.
items.user_impact: None directly observable to a typical user
items.business_impact: Reduced defense-in-depth for XSS/clickjacking on API routes specifically (static pages ARE protected, via public/_headers)
items.security_impact: Real, currently-live gap -- CSP/X-Frame-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/X-XSS-Protection all absent from every /api/* response today
items.recurrence_risk: HIGH until fixed -- will recur on any future hand-rolled entrypoint change unless a shared header-application helper is enforced
items.recommended_wave: WAVE-2 (per implementation-contract.md, requires explicit authorization -- not done this pass, per Cloudflare decision's "no implementation without approval" boundary)
verification: commit 191d299: applySecurityHeaders() exported from functions/_middleware.js, called on all 3 response paths in src/entrypoint.js; verified locally by invoking entrypoint.js's fetch handler directly and confirming CSP/X-Frame-Options/etc. now present on an /api/contact OPTIONS response (previously absent)

Live re-confirmed 2026-08-19T14:52Z: curl -X OPTIONS against the deployed branch preview (claude-init-yi57kn-smile-savers-site-main.lablaunchpad.workers.dev/api/contact) now returns the full CSP/X-Frame-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/X-XSS-Protection set plus exact-origin CORS -- previously confirmed absent on this exact endpoint pre-fix (repo-vs-live.md).

items.title: Zero automated test files in the repository
items.description: No test/spec files of any kind exist. CI (quality/build jobs) validates type-checking and build success only -- no behavioral regression proof for contact API, chat API, booking flow, or any business logic. PARTIAL PROGRESS (commit <pending>): 11 tests now cover the two riskiest Wave-1-changed behaviors (contact API fail-closed, chat rate limiting), proven to catch regressions by reverting the original bug and confirming the suite fails. Booking flow, content schemas, and everything else remain untested.
evidence: file inventory, confirmed via find . -iname "*.test.*" -o -iname "*.spec.*" returning nothing
items.user_impact: Regressions in contact/chat/booking flows can ship undetected
items.business_impact: Silent breakage of the two real conversion paths (contact form, appointment request)
items.security_impact: Security-relevant behavior (e.g. the fail-closed fix in DEBT-0002) has no regression test protecting it from being silently reverted
items.recurrence_risk: HIGH -- every fix in this session (DEBT-0001 through DEBT-0010) has zero automated regression protection

items.title: Security and performance checks are non-blocking by design
items.description: npm audit and Lighthouse CI both use continue-on-error/advisory patterns; release can proceed regardless of findings.
items.user_impact: None directly
items.business_impact: A high-severity dependency vulnerability or major performance regression would not block deployment
items.security_impact: Release-critical properties currently have no enforcement mechanism
items.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM

items.title: CI Node version mismatch between workflows
items.description: deploy.yml uses Node 22; security.yml uses Node 20 -- security verification does not run against the same runtime as the production build.
items.user_impact: None directly
items.business_impact: Low -- but a real inconsistency that could mask Node-version-specific dependency issues
items.security_impact: None
items.recurrence_risk: LOW

items.title: Appointment flow presents a WhatsApp message draft as a completed booking
items.description: BookingWizard builds a prefilled WhatsApp message and immediately shows a success state, with no backend reservation or clinic confirmation step.
items.user_impact: A patient may believe an appointment is confirmed when only a message draft was opened (which they must still send, and which the clinic must still confirm)
items.business_impact: Missed-appointment risk, patient frustration, potential double-booking confusion
items.security_impact: None
items.recurrence_risk: HIGH -- this is a product/UX decision (rename to "request" vs. build real scheduling), not a small code fix
items.recommended_wave: WAVE-2 or later, needs product decision

items.title: Medical/clinical claims have no structured provenance or review metadata
items.description: src/content/services and related collections contain clinical outcome/duration/longevity claims with no source, reviewer, or review-date fields in their frontmatter schema.
items.user_impact: Patients may rely on claims that become stale or were never clinically verified
items.business_impact: Healthcare-content compliance and trust risk
items.security_impact: None directly
items.recurrence_risk: HIGH -- needs a clinician/practice-owner decision on which claims need sourcing, not something engineering can decide alone
